rationale: Load-bearing TokenKey divergences in the Antigravity (cloudcode-pa) client fingerprint that an upstream merge would silently clobber. Aligned to Antigravity CLI (`agy`) on-wire identity (2026-08-23); see docs/ops/antigravity-fingerprint-changelog.md and tokenkey-antigravity-fingerprint-alignment skill. oauth.go/client.go are upstream-shaped; a merge reverting UA format silently de-aligns egress. Single source of truth read by scripts/preflight.sh and upstream-merge-pr-shape.yml.

sentinels.rationale: TokenKey mirrors Antigravity CLI (`agy`) User-Agent: `structured aidev_client UA with build CL and consumer auth`. Upstream/sub2api base emits IDE-shaped `antigravity/%s windows/amd64` without the `/cli/` segment — reverting silently breaks CLI fingerprint alignment.

Official daily hostname is the single owner for paid-tier gateway forward and privacy Host. Restoring sandbox.googleapis.com or a second hostname literal sends Pro/Ultra traffic to the wrong host again.
Paid-tier membership and privacy Host must stay derived from TierIDToPlanType / DailyBaseURL. A second hardcoded Host or paid-tier list will drift from the official daily owner.

On-wire-confirmed: real `agy` CLI sends NO X-Goog-Api-Client(gl-node) on setUserSettings/fetchUserInfo. TK removed the pinned `gl-node/22.21.1`. An upstream merge re-adding it re-introduces a header the CLI never sends. Locked by client_test.go TestPrivacyCalls_无GlNode且UA带cli.

Gemini-native image config passthrough, edge transform side. buildGenerationConfig emits generationConfig.imageConfig.{aspectRatio,imageSize} from ClaudeRequest.ImageConfig, gated on IsImageModel so chat models never get an imageConfig. ImageSize (512/1K/2K/4K; 512 = 0.5K) must travel with aspect ratio or Chat Studio extra_body.image_size is silently dropped. Pairs with the prod-side gateway_forward_as_chat_completions_tk_image.go injection sentinel (gateway-tk.json).

Claude→Gemini transform must set responseModalities TEXT+IMAGE for IsImageModel. Chat Completions conversion never carries modalities; without this, Messages/Claude image_gen returns empty content. Pairs with EnsureImageResponseModalities wrap injection and TestBuildGenerationConfig_ImageModelSetsResponseModalities.

Claude→Gemini transform must use ResolveV1InternalRequestType so plain-text omits requestType (anti-VALIDATION_REQUIRED). Upstream always set requestType=agent; a merge that restores the literal would silently re-enter the agent risk pool. Pairs with request_type.go + gateway wrap sentinels in gateway-tk.json.

Agent envelopes must declare enabledCreditTypes GOOGLE_ONE_AI on the first Claude→Gemini request. Upstream has no credits field; a merge that drops this assignment silently returns to 429-then-inject and burns a failed round trip. Pairs with AgentEnabledCreditTypes in request_type.go and the native wrap sentinel in gateway-tk.json.

Antigravity NeutralizeSystemIdentity must strip Claude Code Dual-use content-gate fragments and rewrite Pi coding-agent openers before identity rewrite. Dropping either reintroduces fake RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 429 (Wei-Shaw/sub2api#8824 / #8791).
Known Dual-use trigger sentence owner for Antigravity forward only. Upstream merges that delete this file or broaden the strip to unrelated security text regress #8824.
Regression coverage for Pi opener rewrite and mid-prompt Dual-use strip through NeutralizeSystemIdentity.

must_contain: model discovery redirect changed serving endpoint
sentinels.rationale: Account discovery must bind to its inference endpoint: a paid daily Argon-disabled catalog must not be replaced by prod capability via fallback or redirect.
Regression coverage for endpoint isolation across success, 404/429/503 and redirects; arbitrary endpoints must never receive the OAuth token.
Admin model discovery must use the same account endpoint selector as inference rather than the legacy prod-first model list.
Quota model visibility must reflect the actual serving endpoint so disabled Argon is not advertised using a different endpoint.
